content.text: Submitted. The repaired proposal keeps the locked `missing` status and inserts a single new Section 31 at the preferred level, with the offending post-term tail ("and for one (1) year thereafter") removed so the clause carries only the six preferred elements — CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M tied to TrueLink's hosting and processing of Client data, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request. Validation returned ok:true with minimality satisfied and the Force Majeure text untouched.
